title: Quotient-remainder Mirror compositional embeddings
hypothesis: Factorized q/r Givens coordinates generalize useful embedding functions to held-out quotient-remainder combinations beyond fixed addition, multiplication, or concatenation without paying for independent token tables.
physical_object: two small complementary quotient and remainder embedding tables
mirror_coordinate: m(q,r)=alpha_q+beta_r; Givens rotation of the concatenated partition vectors

model.data: Synthetic q×r token task. A teacher uses two 8D partition vectors and a factorized Givens angle alpha_q+beta_r to produce class labels. A seed-locked 25% of q×r pairs is held out from training; train, validation, and test examples include seen and held-out pairs. The same vocabulary and teachers are used by each method within a world.

controls: Mirror factorized Givens view with alpha_q+beta_r
free per-pair Givens angle diagnostic on seen combinations only
development_gate_before_fresh: Both development seeds: independent seen-pair accuracy >=0.80; Mirror seen-pair accuracy within 0.02 of the best fixed native composition; Mirror held-out-pair accuracy >=0.05 absolute above concatenation; Mirror actual payload <=1.10x the best fixed composition and <=0.50x independent table; exact uniqueness and collision counts over all 144 pairs; serialized-state CPU throughput >=0.90x concatenation. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh worlds satisfy quality, unseen-combination, storage, uniqueness, runtime and exact-replay gates; Mirror improves the fixed native quality-byte frontier.
failure_gate: Any development seed misses a registered gate or a simple fixed composition matches Mirror's held-out quality at comparable/lower bytes. Fresh remains sealed.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload after reload
paid_objects: all alpha_q and beta_r Mirror codes

boundaries: held-out q×r combinations are not trained
logical combination count is not independent capacity
fresh seeds remain sealed unless all development gates pass
